title: D09: occluded placement (zoo_long_arm), verdict overlays under two sensor configurations

outcome.text: SUCCESS (long arm, G06 scored seed 0). The hand hovers over the platform through the dwell; the overhead camera cannot see the cube and stably-placed stays unknown with its re-observe fallback; the front camera decides the placement.

notes: See docs/results/g09-report.md.
